_readme: sleepIn: the lady who shares Sam's bed in an Owner's Suite (Sam tab → Home). trust = minimum trust; weekly: trustGain, mood, rest (her energy), samRest (Sam's energy); eventChance = odds per week of an evening/morning proposal when she is eager.
Tuning numbers. Change them and reload; no code needed.

amenities: effect numbers for the house amenities (data/economy.json → upgrades has cost, upkeep and wording; amenitySize has the rooms). raceDraw = multiplier on that race's weight when candidates are rolled, while a Tethering Stone (spirit) or Charging Alcove (android) is built in ANY house. sigil.samDrain = share of the usual energy a demon takes from Sam in a house with the sigil. chapel: keepers aren't propositioned; they offer visitors what they're willing to give, nothing penetrative (tier 3) unless a Lantern Angel keeps the chapel (h.lanternChapel), else their best lighter service; a restless keeper may go all the way anyway, a chapel scandal (prestige.chapelClass reversed, plus chapelScandal per act up to chapelScandalCap off the week's class). Only while a Lantern Angel keeps the chapel does it become a Lantern Chapel: vestry offerings need no room and scale with tierMult (+lanternTier3Coin at tier 3), house lust build x lanternLust, keepers are lanternWilling more likely to offer, the whole house's reckless nights cost no class, and demons can serve alongside her at demonLanternMult (0.85). A Chapel Keeper (angels, 2 per house) adds rep (reputation, scaled by repGain) and pop (popularity) each week, gets mood and trust, grants angelHouseMood to whole-house mood while an angel keeps it, visitorClass {class: x} = pilgrim / cleric clients raise visitors and donations: x (1 + sum of (that class's share of the week's courtesan clients) x (value - 1)), and visitors leave donations = visitors x donation x (0.5 + charm/100). garden: mood and health (mends wear, see rest.wear) each week for everyone in the house, elves get elfMult times both. incense: mutually exclusive scent focus on h.incense (calm, aphro, focus, velvet, amber); beastMult = how much stronger beastkin feel every effect (multiplier deltas from 1 and additive bonuses like mood, sat, appeal, lewdDrop); pushy = pushy-client/incident multiplier, lust = weekly lust build multiplier, prop = propositions multiplier, skillGain/statGain/trustGain/energyRec/actEnergy/clientFee = multipliers, mood/sat/appeal = weekly additive bonuses; lewdDrop = service-comfort lewdness bonus under aphro (never stored). workshop.perDwarf = share of the build markup removed per dwarf in the house each week (h.wsDisc, max 1, reset on any purchase). laundry.decay = multiplier on weekly tidiness loss. drinks: per drinks tier (h.drinks 0-3) bar[] multiplies bartender income, props[] multiplies the bar's proposition boost (jobs.barProps) and upkeep[] is the weekly cost (needs the Bar). classroom: the teacher (job teacher) raises each other lady's skill in the subject by floor((hers below teacher) x rate) (or round((gap x rate + statFlat) x ...) for stats), x humanMult for humans; teacherGrow / teacherStatGrow = skill / stat growth for the teacher, learnXP = Wits growth for each lady taught per week (the teacher gets 1.5), mood / trust = her weekly gains. decor: demand[tier] multiplies client demand, noble = extra weight for noble clients at the top tier, upkeep = gold per tier per week.

houses: buying a house outright costs its deed price x max(buyMin, weeks into this cycle x buyPerWeek) x (1 + priceStep for each house already owned beyond the first) (houseCost in commands.js). The NG+ new house goes on the loan instead and ignores this. repairBase / repairStep: cost to repair one damaged room in a fixer-upper house (repairBase + repairedCount x repairStep). upkeepMult: every house's weekly upkeep x this (Office focus cuts it).
solo: energyCost = share of her max energy a solo night costs; she spends one of the week's nights alone instead of with clients (lustDrop = how much it lowers her lust).
doubleDate: trust = the trust (0-100) a lady who isn't Devoted needs to go on double dates (lovers always can).

yuri: instead of a solo night, a restless lady may seek out a free housemate (week.js yuriNight): chance x sapphicMul/biMul; both need lewd (+ clients.women.gap unless Sapphic/Bisexual), the housemate otherLust lust and some energy; picked by bond (1 per bondWeight), her lust and her leaning. Both lose that night with clients, spend energy and lust (the housemate otherShare of it), gain mood, lewdGain lewdness (up to lewdCap) and bond. The service is the heaviest both are up for (by th), pictured as pair:<act>:fem:<other>; text: flavor sam.json → yuri_night + the service's pair.fem line.

lovers: neglectWeeks = weeks in a row without Sam before she feels left out (when another lover isn't); missedMood = mood lost each week she's restless and Sam doesn't see her; jealousyChance = weekly odds of that event. Shared scenes are tuned in bonds.json.

breakup: mood / trust = what ending it costs her (Loyal ladies lose half the trust); rekindleTrust = trust she needs before Sam can ask her back; rekindleChance = base odds she says yes (better if she's happy); rekindleCooldown = weeks between attempts.

lust: low = below this she turns down the heavier services; receiveMin = minimum lust for sexual receiving services; eager = she's in the mood (bonuses below); high = 'restless' (solo nights, reckless nights, lovers come looking for Sam).

lust.build: weekly gain = base + lewdness*perLewd (+eagerTrait for Eager/Exhibitionist, +resting), times her personality's lustBuild and her lustBuild fx (races, traits: data/races.json, data/traits.json).

lust.drop: how much each thing lowers it right away: private = private time with Sam, train = practicing with Sam. Client services now use the per-service 'lust' value in services.json (x technique etc.); client/fav here are the legacy fallback for services without one. Giving services, kisses and massages build lust only with Sam (with clients, only for ladies with the svcLustBuild fx, e.g. Insatiable). Lewder ladies drop less per act (dropAtLewd0 → dropAtLewd100). samRelease: Sam's private time and practice spend drop.private / drop.train x (min + (max-min) x his Technique/100).
lust.profile.floorPerLewd: her lust never falls below lewdness × this (a very lewd lady is never fully sated).
Insatiable / Slow to Warm and the race multipliers are now fx in data/traits.json and data/races.json (lustBuild, lustDrop, lustFloor, lustMax). lust.traitChance = odds a generic lady has the trait.
lust.bonus: extra mood/trust from private time with Sam when she's eager or restless (trainMult scales it for practice sessions); clientMood = mood per client service while eager.

renewal: her willingness = (trust×0.6 + mood×0.4)/100 (+loyal for Loyal ladies). At freeAt or above she re-signs for free; below that the fee scales up toward feeWeeks × her wage; below refuseBelow she's thinking of leaving and may say no. raise = size of the raise option; raiseBoost = how much it helps her willingness.

wages: contracts renew at her current going rate (wageFor, which rises with her skills and popularity). Between renewals she asks for a raise once her wage falls below askAt × her going rate (askAtAmbitious for Ambitious/Greedy). wages.formula: a lady's going rate (wageFor in character.js) = (base + avg stat (0-100) x stat + best skill x tech + popularity x pop + trait extras) x (1 + curve x ((stat+skill+popularity)/300)^2) x race wage x reborn raise. askAt/askAtAmbitious: when she asks for a raise.

mood: restingPoint = the mood she drifts back toward each week (drift = how fast); overworkAt = how many clients a week before she feels overworked (8 since the six-night week: energy is the main brake, this only bites past a full week of services; madame/attendant raise it).
income.escort: multiplier on all escort and off-duty service fees; qualFloor + qualSlope * q^qualPow converts qualityOf (0..1+) to the fee multiplier (novices barely cover, veterans shine).

demolish: share = fraction of an item's base price (no inflation) it costs to demolish a built amenity, or the last bedroom / staff quarters above the house's starting count. Frees the space, lowers h.spent by the base price, never refunds. Built-in amenities can't be demolished; neither can the Bathhouse, Stage or Bar while someone holds the job that needs it.

ngplus: New Game+ (after paying off the debt). Sam always keeps his home house; his starter houses (S.starters: the first house plus the new house taken each cycle) and any house whose story is finished are kept by default but the player can surrender them on the Houses step (NGS.keep) (rooms, tier, upgrades, beds); other houses are sold for saleValue x their price (0 = surrendered), which reduces the new debt instead of adding gold. New debt = home house debt x debtShare x (1 + perCycle for each cycle after the second) + improvementsValue x improveShare (improvementsValue = gold spent on rooms, tiers, quarters, beds, annex and upgrades in all kept houses, tracked in h.spent). purse = Sam's starting gold (same as a new game; his savings stay behind; the Deep Pockets perk adds 2,500). samReset: stats = Sam keeps his level but his stats are rebuilt as sam.base + sam.perLevel x (level-1) + his past lives; appraisal = Appraisal level and XP start over (past lives such as otaku re-apply their floor). Only Devoted lovers come along (they draw wages again, stats reset: named ones to their data values, generic ones to 50%, popularity 0, trust and lewdness back to where they started: named from data, generic from when they were rolled, else baseTrust/baseLewd) and each picks one NG+ perk (traits.json ngPerk). NG+ houses (economy.json ngplus) and NG+ partners (characters.json ngplus) only appear from cycle 2; NG+ houses are bought during the cycle.Sam also takes a new house each cycle (houseOffers deeds, no premium ones; its debt x newHouseShare x (1 + perCycle for each cycle after the second) joins the new debt; its resident comes along) and may add one more past life (economy.json pasts, each once). reborn: every lady who carries over gains a stack of the Reincarnated perk (w.reborn): trust gain x (1 + trust x stacks), skill gain x (1 + skill x stacks), stat gain x (1 + stat x stacks), lewdness gain x (1 + lewd x stacks). friends: old friends: non-lover guests (guests) and generic ladies (generics) whose trust is at least trust (0-100 internal, 100 = maxed) also get a Reincarnated stack but no perk, and wait in S.alumni. Returners: each weekly candidate refresh rolls chance (x the guest multiplier: Wayfarer's Lantern 75%, x paidMul after payoff) for one returner, extra to the normal candidates: an old friend (at most max at a time, stays until hired) or a guest who worked for Sam in a past life (S.lives, back with her stacks, stays like any guest). The first NG+ week always shows one. ngppPurse: Sam's starting gold in NG++ (the Shrine, only the Bound Vessel at first) instead of purse.

ngplus.cycleChallenges: optional goal picked in the NG+ wizard, judged when the debt is paid; clearing it grants its perk for good. within = share of the scheduled payment weeks the payoff must beat. mods / adds = multipliers / additions applied all cycle while it is active, perkMods / perkAdds = the same applied permanently once earned; both use the town-event keys (demand, prop, pushy, upkeep, fee, richFee, lustBuild, lewd, signing, learn, rep, trust, samEnergy, mood) and stack with town events through townMul / townAdd. A challenge with mods/adds and no other goal just needs the debt paid. iron_ledger.tidy = minimum average (over every week of the cycle) of the untidiest house; small_troupe: most staff at any week's end ≤ base + perLover x lovers carried in + perHouse x extra houses kept, fixed when the cycle starts (S.chTrack).

svc: per-service rules. staminaEnergy = services whose services.json stats list stamina cost her energy x (1.1 - stamina/500) on top of the usual stamina discount (false = off). tech* = the range of a client's technique; frustrateAt = a finishing service leaves her frustrated when technique x (her lust/60) is below this (her lust rises by frustrateLust). encore* = chance (+ her encore fx) and fee share of a reckless lady's second round. race* = enthusiast / put-off clients (data/races.json client). demon: demons don't sleep: each working week costs them hunger energy, and they gain energy per finishing service (feed, or feedReckless when restless, which costs house reputation repDrain unless the house has a Binding Sigil); with Sam she gains samGain and Sam loses samExtra more energy. android: recharge fee (fee + perEnergy x energy restored; the Charging Alcove takes chargerDiscount off). refusalMood = beastkin mood loss when Sam turns down a restless request (a Grooming Den halves it).

jobs: barAgil = bartender income x (1 + barAgil x Agility/100), i.e. up to +10% more visitors served. attendantWitsW (was attendantRefW) = Wits weight of an attendant. courtesanTh = how many points lower a courtesan's comfort lines sit; propWant = chance a client asks for a service (courtesans vs. everyone else who steps in); promoter draw = promoterBase + (charm+service)/promoterDiv clients, samples multiply it (samplesDraw), cost samplesEnergy energy, and she gives samplesMin-samplesMax light services from her client menu for free (kiss, massage, hands, breasts, mouth; half energy, no fee or room; shown in the report; samplesLust lust if none fit); her street polish vs house prestige raises or lowers house prestige (prestige.samplesDiv / samplesNegCap / samplesPosCap / samplesCap / samplesGainCap); each sample raises her own popularity by samplesPop x (0.5 + quality) (samplesPopTease if she only teases); attendant: a courtesan with an attendant spends x (1 - help x attendantEnergyPer, never below attendantEnergyMin) energy and her clients gain help x attendantSatPer satisfaction; a house can have as many attendants as courtesan positions, and each courtesan with her own attendant (most popular first) gets attendantOwnMood mood and attendantOwnTrust trust a week; madame: cuts the house's mood losses to madameMoodLoss and matches clients to a fitting lady (+madameMatchSat sat); stepIn* = how many clients a madame/attendant takes when courtesans are swamped and the energy she needs; bar*: each active bartender (max barPropsMax) with a Bar raises the house proposition rate by barProps (x amenities.drinks.props[h.drinks]; applies to propositions to staff and to the share of clients who ask a courtesan for a service), and adds rowdy chance (barRowdy) and client recklessness (barReckless); a bartender earns (barBase + visitors x barPerVisitor) x skill/charm x amenities.drinks.bar[h.drinks], plus tips = visitors x barTips x (0.5 + popularity/100) x (0.5 + charm/100); bath*: massage offers to bathers (bathShare of visitors, bathCap each); tipsBase / danceRep: dancer tips and reputation. promoterBase/promoterDiv: promoter draw = base + (Charisma + Hospitality)/div; x (1 + promoterLowRep x (1 - rep/promoterRepRef)) while the house is little known; the 2nd/3rd promoter x promoterStack^k; each drawn client also spreads the name (repAdd promoterRep x draw). Promoters fill empty rooms: draw beyond the escorts' spare capacity (nightly caps x nights x promoterCapUse - base demand) only counts x promoterOverflow. promoterRead*: promoters read last week's door (h.lastFlow): if clients were turned away, the draw is pulled toward last week's promoter draw minus the turn-aways, by accuracy = promoterReadBase + Wits/promoterReadWits (+ promoterReadBond with a bond >= promoterBondAt to the house's security), best reader leads (hr.promoHeld = clients she didn't bring in).
rooms.perRoom: room-service sessions per bedroom per week; Exhibitionist ladies don't use a room.

tidy: maidPerAgil = extra tidiness per point of the maid's Agility (0-100; an agility-50 maid adds about 8% over an average one). starting value, losses (perService room service, perVisitor), maid gain per week = (maidBase + service skill x maidPerSkill) x outfit bonus x her tidy fx, and the three effect tiers (rep per week, mood, energy recovery multiplier) at high (>=75), low (<45) and bad (<20). maidEase/maidMax: a maid's weekly gain is x (100 - tidiness)/maidEase (at most maidMax), so maids hold a house around a level instead of pinning it at 100: one average maid keeps a 6-8 lady house near 70. Bands: high (>= high) small bonus, neutral up to there, low (< low), bad (< bad) costs reputation, mood, rest and client satisfaction (fx.*.sat).
rep: positive popularity changes are scaled by max(gainMin, gainBase - rep/gainDiv). Losses are not.

prestige: House Class/Prestige (0-100). Each week h.prestige drifts toward a structural target (house base + bedroom tier/beds + drinks + price + amenities + tidiness + full attendant coverage + Madame/Host Charm+Charisma) plus operational shifts (1:1 attendants & charismatic leaders raise it; Exhibitionist open-air acts, free samples compared against house prestige, host fluffing when rooms are full, walkouts, crowding, pushy failures and unshielded demon drains shift/lower it). Low prestige drives demand, staff propositions, action wants, and rowdy/thirsty preference; high prestige draws merchants & nobles, raises skill/amenity/quarters expectations, softens price-tier penalties, boosts company-only work, and rewards rich clients with extra satisfaction & fees when standards are met. reckless / recklessCap / recklessFrom = class lost per client a restless lady picked up off the books (reckless nights; angels never go reckless), x how far the house's class sits above recklessFrom (0 at or below it, full at 100), capped per week. capacity: house capacity by class (classCapMul), x low at class 0, x 1 at mid, x high at class 100 (linear between): scales clients per escort a night (nights), room sessions (rooms.perRoom) and the door's crowd cap (clients.crowd.perSpace). Low class = crowded quick visits, high class = fewer clients for longer.

props: propositions. talkDown = pushy-client chance she talks him down herself before security is tried: (Wits x .6 + Charm x .4)/100 x talkDown; talkMood = her mood change when she has to (negative). penalty/maxPenalty = main-job output lost per accepted proposition (non-must jobs). accept* = chance a non-must lady accepts (acceptBase + (lust-acceptLustMid)/100 + willing fx, +acceptEager when eager, +acceptReckless when reckless); alt / altMust = chance of a counter-offer. attendantExpect = share of attendant propositions where the client expected her to offer (expectSat if she declines). self* = reckless ladies propositioning clients. Pushy resolution: security power vs a roll in securityRoll; else Sam (if his energy >= samEnergyMin) checks strength + charm/2 + roll(0..samRoll) >= samCheck; else none. Costs/mood effects follow. When security fails and Sam is at the house with the energy, he steps in on the spot (samRescue, the samCheck roll); nobody stopping it costs the none penalties. nights: work nights in a week (the seventh day is the rest day). A pushy client nobody stops (Sam too tired, or his step-in fails) ends her night: no more clients or offers for her that night, 1/nights of her job's output, and nightHealth Health. Sam steps in on the spot when he has samEnergyMin energy (Strength + Charm/2 + samRoll vs samCheck, +watchBonus if he stood watch); there is no more after-report event. recklessMin/recklessMax = how many clients a restless lady picks up herself in a week; reckFee = her fee then (she asks, so she takes what he offers).

houseGate: ladies who come with a house (role 'house') can't trust Sam past base + perBeat x (that house's story beat) until the house story is finished (3 beats: 40 + 20 x 3 = 100). Arc beats for them wait for the story too. gap = weeks before beat 1 / 2 / 3 can start (first, later, later); retry = weeks before a beat comes back after a failed check.

wardrobe: costMult scales every outfit/underwear price (lower = easier to get clothes). eventChance = relative weight of each of the 'someone gave her an outfit' random events (data/events.json). cut: paid ladies' baseline profit cut = base + perCycle per NG+ cycle (at most maxBase), + perLover for each lover carried into this cycle (S.ngLovers).

svc.askMore: after a service that didn't finish her (built lust or left her frustrated), a lady with sufficient lewdness and lust may ask the client for more (chance, modulated by client stamina), offering a lust-spending/finishing service she enjoys; it pays fee x its normal price. svc.poorFinishAt / svc.secondRound: clients who didn't finish (non-finishing act or quality below poorFinishAt) or who have stamina left may propose another round.

svc.demon: kissFeed = energy a demon draws from a client's kiss; kissSam (+ kissSamDraw when she's eager, costing Sam kissSamCost extra) from Sam's. restDrainChance / restRepDrain: a restless demon on her week off may drain some poor man in town (town reputation loss; a Demon Sigil doesn't help outside). studCost / studGain / studLust: Sam pays for a stud for the night (sheet button, once a week). hungerDrive: a demon's hunger counts like lust for propositions: drive = lust + (1 - energy/max) x hungerDrive. It lets her proposition clients herself once drive reaches her reckless line (a hungry, not lusty, demon then picks services that feed her), raises her odds of accepting clients' propositions, and she can always take a feeding service she has the energy for. recklessLust / recklessEnergy: a demon is reckless (restless) at lust >= recklessLust (instead of lust.high; her lust max is 120) or whenever her energy is below recklessEnergy.

again: after private time with Sam, a visit or an encounter, a lady who was worked up going in (judged by her lust before the first round) may want another round (chance by race, other = everyone else except spirits, + her encore fx; beastkin only need to be eager, others nearly restless). samCost = Sam's energy; mood = her mood gain (twice for beastkin). Once a week each. Ladies who come to Sam because they are restless only pick services that spend lust (releaseSamAct).

sam: Sam's house-wide actions. roundsTrust / roundsMood = what Making the rounds gives every lady (trust is 0-100 here, so 0.4 shows as 4); lessonShare = share of a one-on-one training gain that each lady in a lesson gets. base = Sam's starting stats in a new game (and the base for the NG+ rebuild); perLevel = each stat gained per level (samGainXP).
lewd: lewdness gains go through lewdUp(w, n, cap) (character.js): see its _note. Dates add their own caps (dates.json lewdCap, spicy cap).
jobs.bathJoinLewd / bathJoinFee: a bath attendant comfortable with massages and at least this lewd joins bathers in the water (bath massage, x fee), and may ask for more like anyone else.

debt: 'payments' payments every 'every' weeks from when the debt started (NG+ restarts it). Payment n = total x share_n; shares ramp linearly from 1 to 'ramp' (the last is ramp x the first) and sum to 1, so there is no balloon; the last payment clears whatever remains (penalties included). A missed payment adds penalty x its amount to the debt and carries over to the next; 'strikes' misses end the game. debt.ngplus: New Game+ loans are due sooner: each cycle past the first has 'fewer' fewer payments (never below minPayments) and a ramp lowered by 'flatter' (never below minRamp), so the early payments are bigger; ngBegin stores the plan in S.debt.payments/ramp.

debt.houseMult: every house's base debt (economy.json → houses.<id>.debt) x this, via houseDebt(id): the cycle-1 debt, and the base NG+ shares are built from it. 1.2 since 2026-11-17 (the bot started finding walk partners and cycle 1 dropped to ~24 weeks).
clients: pickier customers as a house gets famous: satisfaction loses (effective reputation - pickFrom) x pickPer.

refine: Refinement x House Class. refK = (house class - from)/(100 - from), 0..1; refScore = (her Refinement 0-100 - 50)/50, clamped -0.5..1. Each role is x (1 + weight x refScore x refK): fee = every courtesan / step-in service fee in that house, madame = her madame strength (matching, fees, overwork shield), host = how well a host soothes waiting clients, attendant = attendant quality, chapel = chapel donations. sat = flat client satisfaction x refScore x refK. So a rough house ignores Refinement, and an upscale one pays for polish and punishes the lack of it. Courtesans, hosts and attendants also pick up a little Refinement each week in an upscale house.

quarters: staff expect better lodging as the house gets famous: expected comfort = floor(house rep / repPerLevel), max 3; comfort = min(bed level, bedroom refurbishment tier). Each level short costs moodPer mood a week (not for ladies who don't sleep, nor those already on the floor).

arcs: romance arcs. need[i] = trust for beat i, gap[i] = weeks since her last beat. Extras: beat 2 needs a date or private time with Sam, dates['4'] dates for beat 4, private['5'] private times for beat 5.

ngplus.carry: share of what a carried lady (lover or old friend) gained in stats, job skills and service skills above her starting values that she keeps into the next cycle; Sam keeps the same share of his training/story stat gains. Ladies keep more with each life: carryPer x the life she is entering (her 2nd life 20%, 3rd 30%...), at most carryMax, never below carry. rebornWage: each Reincarnated stack raises her wage by this share (wageFor). ngplus.cap: stats and skills top out at base + perCycle x (cycle-1) (ladies 1000, 1100, 1200...; Sam's 0-100 stats use a tenth of that). Trust, lewdness, mood, energy and health are unaffected.

feast: Throw a feast (house tab), once per house per week, no action. Each tier: cost per lady in that house, trust (0-100 scale, still capped by house stories) and mood each lady gets. Wording is in each tier's text.

sam.bonus: Sam's stats (0-100) also work passively, scaled by stat/100: charm = extra share of trust every lady gains, business = extra share of weekly house income, security = Strength x this added to every house's security, rest = extra share of his weekly recovery at Strength 100, wits = extra share of stat training and Appraisal XP. energyPerCycle: Sam's max energy is 100 + this x (cycle-1). Sam gains +1 action every 5 levels.

samHome: Sam sleeps in one house (S.samHome, default his home house). His weekly recovery (weekly) and naps (nap) scale with that house's staff bed quality: x rest/ref (economy.json beds); the Owner's Suite (and samUps bedTier) lift him a tier, and every tier past the best bed adds overTier rest instead. Sam's weekly focus and passive bonuses apply only at the house where he sleeps unless he has the Speaking Stones (fx link) or the Shadow Clone boon; late-night encounters, rounds, demonstrations and group nights likewise unless he has the Teleport Circle (fx reach). samUps: Sam's things (Sam tab); carry = kept in New Game+; guild = earned from the Adventurers' Guild instead of bought (a contract id: first clear of that contract; rank1: the Iron rank-up), not sold in the shop; fx: bedTier, weekly (+energy every week), link, reach, and tool fx summed by samUpFx: bartend (+share of Floor bar income), watch (+share of Watch security), books (extra Office upkeep cut), rounds (+share of rounds trust and mood), lesson (+share of class skill gains), scout (+candidates from scouting), guestDraw (x 1 + share on guest visit chance, guest walk weight and guest cooldown speed), workEnergy/trainEnergy/dateEnergy/privEnergy/orgyEnergy (energy saved). The Owner's Suite is a house amenity (economy.json → upgrades.suite).

clients.traits: cheat (Cheapskate) = share of the fee penalty the lady's Wits cancels at 100 (fee 0.8, cheat 0.5: 0.8 at wits 0 to 0.9 at wits 100). Every client (not regulars) rolls 1-3 traits (clients.traitCount = odds of 1/2/3), weighted by w x his class's traits weight (economy.json → classes.traits), skipping excl. hidden: not shown in the report. Keys (all optional): prop (x his chance to want a service / proposition staff), pushy (+ chance he won't take no), pushyMult (x that), rowdy (+ house incident pressure), booze {prop, pushy, rowdy, patience} (added while a bartender works, x (1 + drinks tier x boozeDrinks)), tips (x bar tips), fee (x what he pays), compFee (x when he only wants company), qualityFee [a,b] (fee x (a + quality x b)), selfAccept (+ chance he says yes to a restless lady), likes {races ('beastkin:<sub>' ok), traits (lady traits), restless} with like (enthusiast chance) and draw (pick weight; without a madame only x^nativeMatch), patience (+ chance to wait), open (+ openness to a host's warm-up), thirsty (always wants a service; unserved: thirsty.sat and thirsty.rep), acceptHost (chance he'd rather the host finish him than wait), tech (+ his technique), satAdd (+ satisfaction), hostLike (x host satisfaction bonus), jobProp {job: x his propositions to that job}, stageSpend (x stage spending while waiting), gossip (x his rep effect, clients.gossip.rep per point of satisfaction away from 50), regular (x chance he becomes a regular). stats {stat: weight} = stat taste (see clients.statPref); charmGate {at, below, above} = satisfaction below if her Charm (0-100) is under at, else above; wantStats {stats, mult} = x his chance to ask for a service whose services.json stats include any of them. Client traits never reach image prompts or AI text.

clients.statPref: stat tastes (`stats` on client traits and on economy.json classes; regulars keep their class taste). Score = weighted average of clamp((her stat 0-100 - 50)/50, -0.5, 1), 0 = nothing preferred. draw: x (1 + draw x score) on his pick weight (madame match and free choice); sat: + sat x score satisfaction; fee: x (1 + fee x score) on the main service fee (this is what makes Nobles pay for Refinement). Never used in AI text, image prompts or encounter entries.

clients.nativeMatch: without a madame clients mostly take whoever is free: appeal and race/trait draw count only to this power. clients.wait: with a madame or busy courtesan, everyone waits instead of being immediately turned away: waiting costs sat (canceled by a host, softened to soothedSat when the bar (barCalm + barDrinksCalm per tier) or dancers (danceCalm) entertain him); unattended waiters may leave unhappy (waitLeaveBase / overflow without host/bar/dance), hurting satisfaction (leaveSat), reputation (leaveRep per walkout), and raising incident odds (+leaveIncident per walkout). Waiting clients spend barSpend at an open bar / stageSpend at a staffed stage. Security at the door screens clients by Wits (boosting noble/merchant weights via screenMerchant/screenNoble, trimming commoners via screenTrimLow, and filtering rowdy/troublesome traits via screenSafe/screenGood) and caps excessive overflow past doorQueue+hostQueue/barQueue/stageQueue using secStopBase + secPow/secStopDiv at minimal rep cost (secStopRep, reduced up to secGraceCut by guard Charm/Charisma). clients.crowd: house capacity = houseSize x perSpace; guests entering past that suffer escalating satisfaction penalties (over x satPer + over^2 x satQuad, capped at satCap), bail/walkout risk (bailPer, calmPer), reputation loss (repPer, repQuad), unsatPer, and incidentPer; security stops excess at the door past capacity. clients.host: sat is x (0.6 + her Charm/125); each host entertains perWeek x (1 + service skill/100 x skillPer x 10) waiting clients per week (x outfit/job bonus x her output after accepted propositions; each accepted proposition costs propCost, a warm-up or entertaining 1 each), +sat (+satSkill x quality); clients at least fluffOpen open (0.3 + the open of his traits) get a warm-up (what she is comfortable with, from kiss / massage / manual / oral / breast give; not if she is set to Off) (a light service in the open, never finished): +fluffSat (+fluffSkill x quality), quality boost (fluffQBase + fluffQGap x (1 - quality)) x hostEffectiveness (fluffEffBase + fluffEffSkill x HostSkill/100), and fluffEnergyMult energy cost on his courtesan visit, tip fluffFee x service price, at most fluffMax per client; a client with acceptHost may have her finish him instead (finishShare of a normal fee, costs finishCost of her capacity); accepted propositions cost propCost. thirsty / gossip: see clients.traits.

ngplus.bonds: when two ladies both reincarnate (carried lovers, old friends, or alumni still waiting to be re-hired), their bond carries into the next cycle at keep x its value (0.5 = halved; 1 = untouched; 0 = reset), and its kind (mentor, comrades, ...) stays unless kinds is false. The sheet marks such bonds '(from a past life)'. Bonds with anyone else are dropped as before.

jobs.attendant*: an attendant's quality = (Hospitality x attendantSkillW + Charm x attendantCharmW + Wits x attendantWitsW)/100 x outfit/job bonus x her output, capped at attendantQMax (an average attendant is about 0.5, a top one 1+). The most popular courtesans each get their own attendant (best attendant first); the others share attendantShared x the average quality. A courtesan's service energy cost x (1 - help x attendantEnergyPer, never below attendantEnergyMin) and her clients' satisfaction + help x attendantSatPer; her own attendant also gives her attendantOwnMood / attendantOwnTrust x (0.5 + quality/2). Low-skill attendants mostly just step in when the courtesans are swamped.

amenities.classroom (teaching formula): each lady behind the teacher gains floor(gap x rate x teacher x learner) (stats use round((gap x rate + statFlat) x teacher x learner)). teacher = (base + Management/100 x manageW + Wits/100 x witsW) x outfit/job bonus (teacher) x her teach fx x her output; learner = (learnBase + Wits/100 x learnWits) x her learn fx (x humanMult for humans). An average teacher and learner come to about 1. Subject (h.teachSkill): a skill, a stat ('stat:<key>'), a service, or a set (all skills / all stats / all services / everything / a job's stats + skill, plus services for menu jobs); a set of n subjects teaches each at rate x n^-setExp. Services can only be taught by a teacher who knows them and has lewdness >= the service's th + svcLewd.

tutor: paid tutoring per lady (her sheet → Tutoring; js/logic/spending.js). Each week at the week's end Sam pays cost (x tier cost, x 1 + perCycle x (cycle-1)) for every lady with a tutor; skipped with a report note if the purse can't cover it. focus weak = her `weakStats` lowest stats (by statOf) at stat each and her `weakSkills` lowest trade skills at skill each; focus job = the stats her job uses (train.stat.byJob weights) at stat x weight, her job's skill at skill, other skills x others, and for menu jobs every menu service at svc. All gains x tier gain x her learn fx and personality 'train' liking. herEnergy = her energy per week; counts toward counts.lessons.

gifts: buying gifts for trust (her sheet → Gifts). tiers {cost, trust, mood}: trust goes through gainTrust (diminishing near the top, house-story caps still apply), mood x personality 'gift' liking (Greedy x greedy). Each gift to the same lady in one week costs x weekMul^(gifts so far this week), so the second costs double and the third four times as much; cost x (1 + perCycle x (cycle-1)). beforeDebt: 'locked' (only once the debt is paid), 'action' (before that, each gift costs one of Sam's actions and energy; free after) or 'free'. Counts as a gift (counts.gifts).

goddess: the overarching story (js/logic/goddess.js, wording in data/goddess.json, docs/GODDESS.md). fullReborn = Reincarnated stacks that count as fully reincarnated (max carry); the binding comes at the first rebirth after a lady has lived such a life (reborn > fullReborn). events: before the binding, chance per week = base + perCycle x (cycle-1), at most max, at least gap weeks apart; bound = chance of a jealous remark after the binding (x 0.5 + jealousy/100). jealousy 0-100: perHire per new lady, perPrivate per private moment with someone else, perLady per lady past rosterRef, -decay weekly, perLover x lovers carried + perCycle at each rebirth before the binding, nightCut when Sam spends a night with her; mid/high = text tiers. love 0-100: bind (at the binding), night, talk; stay = love needed for her to stay at full divinity. mood: drifts toward base + love x perLove - jealousy x perJealous; below ignoreBelow she half the time ignores your guidance. divinity 0-max: bindTo after the binding, +finish per night, 1 action + 1 per perAction. power = (base + perDiv x divinity) x (1 + perReborn x (fully reborn ladies + their lives past full)) x lantern conduit multiplier (perAngel per working Lantern Angel up to maxAngels, perChapel per active Lantern Chapel up to maxChapels). lantern: synergy numbers for bound Seliora (bizMult, clientMult, watchBonus/watchMood, tutelageMult, indulgeEnergy/Mood/GodMood/GodJeal, chapelJealDecay, shrineEcho). actions: indulge (ladies with the most lust: lust off, mood, energy, lewd), business (income share and rep in a random house), watch (chance she stops each pushy client in the house with the most trouble, max), tutelage (the least skilled working lady: job skill + a stat), whim (random of those x mult), claim (jealousy/per chance per action: she keeps Sam up (samEnergy) or monopolizes a new lady (mood)). night: AP + cost energy; a finishing tier-3 service (inside her) gives Sam restore + perDiv x divinity energy, +divinity.finish, love.night, mood; finishing outside: half the energy, love.outside, outsideMood; no finish: -noneLove, -noneMood. neglect: from `after` weeks without a night, -love/-mood every week; a jealous claim on a lady with no night within claimWeeks: -claimLove/-claimMood. indulge.practice = service skill the lady gains. actions.guild.progress: guild work focus: contract progress per action x her power, on the active contract with the most work left (no contract: business instead).

svc.angel: an angel (non-guest) whose lewdness reaches lanternLewd can become a Lantern Angel. With trust >= lanternTrust she asks Sam first (accepting: +lanternAcceptTrust trust, +lanternAcceptMood mood; refusing: lanternRefuseMood). Below that her personality decides: lewd multiplier >= 1 and not Modest takes it on her own (+lanternAutoMood); a reserved one waits until she trusts Sam enough to ask, or gives in at lanternLewd + lanternOwn. lanternReckFee = share of full client fee earned by a Lantern Angel on reckless nights.

rest: energy. Max energy = maxBase + maxPerStamina x Stamina (0-100) (+ maxEnergy fx): Stamina is how much she has. Recovery: her bed (economy.json beds rest) x energyRec fx x (strBase + strPer x Strength/100) x incense x tidiness: Strength is how fast she gets it back. After each work night she sleeps: that x night (never above her max). The rest day adds that x restDay; a week off x week (+ bath with a Bathhouse). Services cost their services.json energy (no Stamina discount any more). wear: each work night costs Health nightBase + nightPerSpent x (energy spent that night / max) (x her fatigue fx; dwarves 0.4), an unhandled pushy client props.nightHealth more, and recovery is cut by (100 - Health)/100 x per (at most max); a week off heals restHeal Health, a Garden mends amenities.garden.health a week (elves double). So a lady who only does her job is roughly energy-neutral but slowly wears down, and one who takes a lot of propositions or clients runs down fast. Auto-rest (her sheet, on by default) takes her off below 35% energy or once wear cuts autoRest of her recovery, and back at 85% energy; while auto-resting she keeps her job (shown as resting) and its position, and static effects of it stay (a madame still adds her courtesan positions), but she does none of the work. Below 30 Health she is unwell and must rest. Androids charge to full every night (for a fee per energy, paid at the week's end) and feeding demons never wear down; spirits take no bed but recover like everyone else at the house's bed tier (their nerf is lower max energy, races.json fx maxEnergy).

nights: the week runs night by night (simHouse). Each night an escort takes up to base + Stamina(0-100)/perStamina clients (+ nightCap fx; the fraction is rolled each night), between min and max, while her energy lasts; then she sleeps (rest.night). The cap is x prestige.capacity by house class.

focus: Sam's weekly focus (js/logic/focus.js), worked during the six nights at his house (every house with samReach). cost = energy paid at the week's end (less workEnergy upgrades); with less energy left it runs at energy/cost. xp = Sam XP. rest (Off duty): restEnergy back instead. office: house takings x (1 + incomeBase + perBusiness x Sam's Business, at most incomeMax) at every house in reach (officeMul(); the books: tighter tabs, supplier prices); upkeep cut (booksCut) and madame matching with Sam's madame factor (0.5 + (Business + Wits x0.4 + Charm x0.6)/200) x share without a working madame, x withMadame on top of hers. floor: at houses with a bar, (base + Charm x perCharm + 0-25) x nights gold (x noBar at houses without one: lounge tips); sat = client satisfaction, mood/trust = for the ladies near him. watch: security (20 + Strength) x mult, trust for the ladies near him, and his step-in bonus. classes: skill or stat class at mult x one class.

incidents: smaller trouble on the work nights (simHouse, after the nights): odds per night = base + perGuest x guests a night (at most max), x the house's trouble, rowdiness, bartenders, incense and its class (rowdyTier). Each is a weighted type; security handles it with chance secPow / (secPow + diff x handle.div/40) (Guard Post x handle.guard; Sam's Watch is in secPow), clamped to handle.min..max. Unhandled: gold [min,max] in damages (added to upkeep), tidy (tidiness lost), sat (client satisfaction, feeds popularity), rep (house popularity lost), prestige, mood / trust (one lady), lostClient (a client's fee lost). Wording: events.json → nightIncidents.

walk.partnerOdds: chance a walk finds a partner, by how many Sam has already found on walks this cycle ([1st, 2nd, 3rd]); partnerCycleMax (3) is the hard cap, so 15 partners spread over five cycles and there is always someone left to pick. NG++: always ngppPartnerOdds (no cap). weights: how likely each other kind of walk is (exLover = a past lover in NG++; partner odds are set by partnerOdds, not a weight).

townEvents: every gap [min, max] weeks (first one from firstWeek) a town event runs for weeks [min, max], in any cycle: list.<id> holds its label, desc and the multipliers it sets while it runs (demand, prop, fee, pushy, upkeep, richFee, lustBuild, lewd, signing, learn, rep, trust; samEnergy and mood are added, mood per week). Wording of the announcement page: events.json → townEvents.<id>. random: false = never rolls on its own (story beats start it, e.g. Isolde's price war). off: true turns them off; only: an id = only that one (for the lab).

isolde: Lady Isolde Thorne of the Velvet Thorn, Sam's rival (js/events/isolde.js, wording data/isolde.json). Beats in order: taunt (from firstWeek weeks into the cycle), visit, pricewar, wager, truce, lovers, each at least gap weeks apart and needing town renown (renown.*). Her story carries over into the next NG+ cycle unfinished; only NG++ restarts it (every NG++ cycle; from NG++ cycle 2 the renown needed is x ngppRenown). pricewar starts the price_war_match / price_war_hold town event for warWeeks. wager: gold stake, renown on a win; your lady's showcase score vs base + perCycle x (cycle-1) +- spread. After the truce: nights (Sam visits on the rest day: visit.energy, every visit.cooldown weeks; or she comes to him after comes.after weeks without one, comes.chance a week). night: Sam's energy cost (lostEnergy more if she wins), Technique gained, her desire per approach, renown when he comes out on top; checkDiv: his Strength+Technique vs her roll. lovers: desire and nights for the lovers beat. referral: once they're lovers, the chance a week the Thorn sends its overflow (base gold x (1 + perCycle x (cycle-1))). games: NG+ cycles after the one her story finished in (not NG++): every gap weeks at most, chance a week, one of her wagers; Sam's chance = checkBase + checkPer x his stat (raise: raiseMinus lower, double gold/renown), gold won or lost, renown on a win, Sam's energy. Poaching stops after the truce.

luxury: paid shortcuts once the debt is paid (Sam tab → Luxuries for tonic/action; house page → Luxuries for the rest). Each costs cost x (its own mul, else weekMul)^(times bought this week; per house for house items) x (1 + perCycle x (cycle-1)); span 'cycle' counts purchases for the whole cycle instead of the week (resets at rebirth). tonic: Sam back to full energy. action: +1 rest-day action for Sam (up to max), using the same decaying markup as rush. campaign: +rep house popularity. spa: every lady living in the house back to full energy, +health; cost is per lady. rush: skip the weeks-to-wait of a house chapter, romance arc or epilogue chapter (button on the wait line, shown once the wait is the only thing missing); cost x markup x (1 + perCycle x (cycle-1)), rounded to 100; each skip multiplies the markup by mul, every week that passes keeps weekDecay of the markup above 1 (0.5 = halfway back to the base price), and it resets each rebirth.

linger: pressure to be reborn when Sam stays on after the debt is paid (js/logic/linger.js, wording goddess/linger.json). Linger level = weeks since payoff - grace (grace = graceBase - graceCycle x (cycle-1), at least graceMin). wane (from level wane.from): Sam's max energy -perLevel per level, at most max. tithe (from tithe.from): each week she takes pct (base + perLevel x levels past tithe.from, at most max) of gold above floor x (1 + floorCycle x (cycle-1)). recall (from recall.from, then every recall.every weeks): one Devoted lover who isn't this cycle's partner (not on a guild contract) sleeps in the lantern until New Game+. off: true turns it all off. waitMul: once the debt is paid, story waits (arc, epilogue and house chapter gaps, weeks between firsts) are x waitMul, rounded down.

clients.women: some clients are women (client.sex 'f') or futanari ('futa'). share = chance per client by tier, x bathMul for bath clients, x (1 + prestigeMul x (house class - 50)/50); futa = share of those women who are futanari. A lady who isn't Sapphic or Bisexual needs gap more lewdness for a woman (a Sapphic one needs it for men instead, and samGap with Sam); futaGap more for a futanari unless she's a Futa Lover. orient = chances a generic lady rolls each of those traits (Sapphic and Bisexual exclude each other).
amenities.incense.<mode>.classFee: extra clientFee cut x house class/100 (amber: rushed visits cost more in classy houses).

lewd._note: Lewdness diminishing returns (lewdUp). Each source has a cap: full gain below cap-band, half at the cap, none past cap+band. Services: cap = service th + capOver. softCap: default cap for sources without one; past it only daring dates, traits and stories push her further.

influence._note: Weekly lewdness that rubs off (lewdInfluence, staff.js). Each pulls her toward min(cap, source lewdness - gap) at up to gain per week (tapering to nothing as she reaches it, via lewdUp); none if the source is below minSrc. madame: source = average lewdness of courtesans who served this week. attendant: source = the courtesan she attended. exhib: perAct x (exhibitionist acts in the house this week, at most maxActs) once there were at least minActs, toward cap, for everyone working except skipJobs, stand-ins and other exhibitionists.

startLewd._note: Generic ladies' starting lewdness: min + span x r^pow (r uniform 0-1). pow > 1 skews low. Race/sub mods still add on top.

train._note: One-on-one training on her sheet (samTrain), no pickers. stat: Sam coaches every stat her job uses (stat.byJob weights, default for jobs not listed); each gains (base + Sam Wits x perWits) x Wits bonus x weight x spread (0-1000 units, diminishing near the cap). skill: every trade skill; her job's skill (Hospitality without one) gets the full gain, the others x others; scales with Technique; no lust or lewdness. service: practice of every service she does with Sam (canSam), each (base + Technique x perTech) x share; warms her up (svcLust x her lewdness, lewd lewdness while her lewdness is below lewdCap). broad: jobs that learn a bit of everything (madame, teacher): stats not in their list at weight stat, other skills at skillOthers instead of skill.others, and in classes every other skill at lesson x the class gain. energy = Sam's, herEnergy = hers. skill.base/perTech: her job's skill gains base + Technique x perTech per session (others x others); herEnergy kept low so a session pays back within a cycle (tools/lab sam-actions-campaign).

trust._note: Trust is 0-100 here (shown to the player x10, out of 1000). minor = the least any time with Sam builds (practice, private time, anything that gave none).

lean_house.label: Lean House
lean_house.desc: Pay off the cycle debt without buying any extra houses, within 85% of the scheduled payment weeks.

ahead_of_time.label: Ahead of Schedule
ahead_of_time.desc: Pay off the debt within 55% of the scheduled payment weeks.
ahead_of_time.perkDesc: −10% future cycle debt & −10% house upkeep permanently.

iron_ledger.label: Spotless Record
iron_ledger.desc: Clear the cycle with 0 missed payment strikes and your untidiest house averaging 75+ tidiness over the whole cycle (checked every week, not just at the end).
iron_ledger.perkDesc: +15 Sam max energy; his Office focus cuts 8 more points of upkeep and his Floor focus earns 15% more at the bar, permanently.

small_troupe.label: Tight Troupe
small_troupe.desc: Never have more than 6 staff across all houses at any week's end, +1 per lover you carried in and +2 per extra house you kept (set when the cycle starts).
small_troupe.perkDesc: +15% trust gain & +15% lady skill gain permanently.

wary_town.label: Wary Town
wary_town.desc: This cycle Hollowmere keeps its distance: 20% fewer clients come in.

hard_bargain.label: Hard Bargain
hard_bargain.desc: This cycle signing bonuses cost 60% more and house upkeep runs 15% higher.

rough_streets.label: Rough Streets
rough_streets.desc: This cycle pushy clients are 60% more likely, and town mood costs every lady 2 mood a week.

short_nights.label: Short Nights
short_nights.desc: This cycle Sam has 30 less max energy.

cold_welcome.label: Cold Welcome
cold_welcome.desc: This cycle the ladies warm up slowly: 35% less trust gain.

no_shortcuts.label: No Shortcuts
no_shortcuts.desc: This cycle training, classes and lessons give 30% less stat and skill growth.

unknown_name.label: Unknown Name
unknown_name.desc: This cycle house popularity grows 35% slower and clients pay 10% less.

faithful_flame.label: Faithful Lantern
faithful_flame.desc: Finish the cycle with Seliora still bound and Love at 75+.
faithful_flame.perkDesc: +20% Goddess weekly power & +25% Vessel awakening speed permanently.

full_vessel.label: Awakened Soul
full_vessel.desc: Awaken your Bound Vessel completely (full personality) before paying off the debt.
full_vessel.perkDesc: +20% skill & stat gain for Reincarnated ladies permanently.

starlight_debt.label: Debt Under Starlight
starlight_debt.desc: Take on +25% starting debt and −25% starting gold for this cycle.
starlight_debt.perkDesc: +15% all house income & +1 permanent Sam action per week.

festival.label: Lantern Festival
festival.desc: Clients flock to Hollowmere (+25% demand, +20% propositions), but pushy incidents rise 20%.

austerity.label: Credit Audit
austerity.desc: House upkeep runs 20% higher, but merchants and nobles pay 20% more when satisfied.

warm_winds.label: Warm Winds
warm_winds.desc: Staff lust builds 40% faster and lewdness grows 25% quicker, with -3 mood a week.

iron_watch.label: City Watch Crackdown
iron_watch.desc: Pushy client risk drops 40%, while signing bonuses cost 25% more.

scholars.label: Academy Exams
scholars.desc: Training, classes and lessons give 40% more stat and skill gains; popularity rises 20% slower.

crimson_nights.label: Crimson Nights
crimson_nights.desc: Sam gets +20 max energy and the ladies gain 30% more trust.

price_war_match.label: Price War (matching)
price_war_match.desc: You match the Velvet Thorn's prices: every client pays 15% less.

price_war_hold.label: Price War (holding)
price_war_hold.desc: You hold your prices while the Velvet Thorn undercuts you: 15% fewer clients come in.

merchant_fleet.label: Merchant Fleet in Port
merchant_fleet.desc: Three galleons moored at dawn (+15% demand, wealthy patrons pay 25% more).

harvest_fair.label: Harvest Fair
harvest_fair.desc: Stalls pack the square (+20% demand, +2 weekly mood, +10% upkeep for extra stock).

rainy_spell.label: Monsoon Week
rainy_spell.desc: Relentless rain keeps casual foot traffic home (-15% demand, +25% lessons & classes, +20% lust build).

masquerade.label: Quarter Masquerade
masquerade.desc: Masked revelry spills across every parlor (+25% propositions, +20% lewdness growth, +15% pushy risk).

alley_rumor.label: Alleyway Gossip
alley_rumor.desc: Whispers circle one house (-10% demand, -15% reputation gains there).

noble_patronage.label: A Noble's Favor
noble_patronage.desc: A titled regular sings one house's praises (+30% merchant/noble fees, +15% reputation gains there).

pipe_trouble.label: Boiler Trouble
pipe_trouble.desc: Burst hot-water mains plague one house (+25% upkeep, -2 weekly mood there).

street_musicians.label: Buskers Outside
street_musicians.desc: Lively street musicians draw crowds past one house (+20% demand, +15% propositions there).

wager_won.label: Festival Wager Won
wager_won.desc: The whole Quarter talks about your victory (+20% demand, +25% renown gains, +10% fees).

wager_lost.label: Festival Wager Lost
wager_lost.desc: The Velvet Thorn basks in its festival win (-10% demand, -15% renown gains).

jobPrefs._note: Rolled job likes/dislikes for generic ladies (and named ones without their own list). Each job's odds: base, plus personality (personalities.json jobsUp/jobsDown), plus trait for each matching trait below, plus ownJob for the job she arrives in. maxLikes/maxDislikes cap the lists.

cutSpend._note: How ladies spend their weekly profit cut at week end (no flat cut bonus; effects come from what she buys, using up her budget each week unless saving briefly for an outfit within reach). Personality & traits shift weights.

tiers.label: Family supper
tiers.text: Sam cooks (badly) and buys the rest (well). {house} eats together for once. Nobody talks about work.

tiers.label: Banquet
tiers.text: Roast, three kinds of pie and a cask of something sweet. The {house} staff toast Sam twice and mean it once.

tiers.label: Grand feast
tiers.text: Musicians, a hired cook and a cake taller than Sam. {house} talks about it for weeks.

calm.label: Calming Lavender
calm.desc: Steady nerves and cool heads. Less lust, calmer nights, +1 mood, and Sam refusals sting less.

aphro.label: Crimson Lotus
aphro.desc: Sweet smoke that wakes desire. +25% lust build, +20% propositions, and +5 comfort lewdness.

focus.label: Scholar's Cedar
focus.desc: Crisp temple wood for practice. +18% skill and stat growth, -10% lust build.

velvet.label: Velvet Myrrh
velvet.desc: Warm, welcoming spice. +3 client satisfaction, +3 appeal, and +15% trust gain.

amber.label: Brisk Ambergris
amber.desc: Bright resin that restores stamina at the cost of shorter visits. -15% act energy, +15% rest recovery, +1 mood; client payouts -5%, and up to -15% more the classier the house (rich clients notice a rushed visit).

coffee.label: Otherworld Coffee Maker
coffee.desc: He rebuilt a drip machine from memory and two dwarven pipes. +10 energy every week.

circle.label: Teleport Circle
circle.desc: A chalk circle in every house that the Credit House does not know about. Sam can step between houses at night: late-night visits, rounds, demonstrations and group nights reach every house. Left behind in New Game+.

stones.label: Speaking Stones
stones.desc: A matched set of sending stones, one on every madame's desk and one in Sam's pocket. Mission control: his weekly focus (office, floor, watch, classes) and his always-on bonuses reach every house. Left behind in New Game+.

kit.label: Bartender's Kit
kit.desc: Proper shakers, a good knife, a bar towel with a history: the baron's own bartender pressed them on Sam. Floor focus earns x1.3 at the bar.

whistle.label: Watchman's Whistle
whistle.desc: The pit referee's brass whistle, loud enough to end an argument two streets away. Watch focus gives x1.5 security.

ledger.label: Enchanted Ledger
ledger.desc: An Exchange ledger that adds itself up and sulks when the sums are wrong. Office focus cuts upkeep a further 10 percentage points.

notebook.label: Little Black Notebook
notebook.desc: Everyone's favorite tea, birthdays and grudges, all in one place. Make the rounds gives x1.5 trust and mood.

wayfarer.label: Wayfarer's Lantern
wayfarer.desc: A brass lantern with a flame that leans toward people who don't belong here. Hung over the door, it draws drifters from other worlds: guests turn up among the candidates and on walks 50% more often, and come back sooner.

chalkboard.label: Slate Chalkboard
chalkboard.desc: The surveyors' big map slate from the Deep Delve, wiped clean for the back row. Classes focus gives x1.3 skill gains.

pass.label: Guild Hall Pass
pass.desc: Hanna's Guild Pass: the clerk waves Sam straight to the good noticeboard. Scout recruits finds +1 candidate.

boots.label: Well-Worn Walking Boots
boots.desc: Delver's boots, resoled by a dwarven cobbler. Sam's weekly focus, guild visits and walks cost 5 less energy.

manual.label: Annotated Coaching Manual
manual.desc: A monster hunter's training log, tabbed and annotated for every exercise. One-on-one coaching, training, practice and demonstrations cost 6 less energy.

cloak.label: Evening Outing Cloak
cloak.desc: A caravan master's warm wool cloak, with pockets for theatre tickets and umbrellas. Dates and chats cost 5 less energy.

tonic.label: Apothecary's Stamina Tonic
tonic.desc: A discreet brown bottle of lustbloom tonic from the Fenwood apothecaries. Tastes terrible, works wonders. Private time costs 6 less energy, and group nights cost 4 less energy per lady.

samCloth._note: Pictures of time with Sam roll how undressed she is each time (samSceneCloth): every level from the service minimum (never fully dressed when more is possible) up to what she is comfortable with, by these weights; her top level counts double. Each level, outfit and underwear set saves its own picture.

lessons._note: Sam's classes (Sam tab; each costs an action). stat: everyone working trains the stats her job uses at share x a one-on-one gain. skill: everyone working learns her job's skill (sam.lessonShare). demo: a demonstration with a partner Sam picks: she has to be open to it (lewdness >= openLewd, or Exhibitionist; never Modest) and does her favorite or furthest service with him (privateCore); everyone else watching learns that service (watchSkill x a practice gain) and warms up (watchLust x her lewdness, watchLewd lewdness up to that service's client line). The partner's demos count (counts.demos) toward Exhibitionist.

orgy._note: A night with several ladies at once (Sam tab → Gather the girls; orgyMenu/samOrgy in sam.js). One action; Sam's energy = perGirl x ladies (+ ramp x ladies x (ladies-1)/2 if you want later ladies to cost more). min-max ladies, all from one house unless Sam has reach (Teleport Circle / Shadow Clone). Each lady needs a service she does with Sam (bestSamAct, through privateCore: her usual private-time effects, lust spent), to be open to sharing (lewdness >= openLewd, Exhibitionist, or lust >= eager), not Modest, and energy >= minEnergy. Every pair: bond + bond. Ladies already at bond >= femBond get a fem/fem vignette with image (pair:<act>:fem:<other>) and +femBondBonus bond. Each: lewdness + lewd (up to her service's Sam line + lewdCapPlus), mood + mood; counts.orgies. minTier: her service must be at least this tier (2 = no kisses or massages). lustAfter: extra lust every lady spends at the end of the night (x her lust drop), on top of her own service.

tease._note: Her distraction in disguise teases (goddess.js gDistractAct). tierByCycle[cycle] = how far she goes (1 kisses/touching, 2 hands & mouth, 3 everything, never to a finish). acts[tier] = services she picks from (a choice/tease 'act' overrides). chance[phase] = odds a choice with resIn ends in a distraction (a choice/tease 'distract' true/false overrides).
